_doc: The Choir (docs/design/17-factions.md) and the World Clock (02-world.md). The clock is 6 segments; each needs progress points. The Choir earns points monthly plus bonuses; player victories subtract.

world_clock._doc_pace: Base 1 point a month: 9:00 at month 36 with no bonuses and no resistance; 12:00 at month 56. Bonuses pull it earlier; the player pushes it back. Target: 9:00 between months 36 and 54 in a normal game.

spread_hum.effect: +1 hum in a hold adjacent to a Hum zone; at hum 3 the hold is Hum-touched

mark_red_circle.effect: target a Hum-touched hold, or one with turned sub-faction presence >= 2; it is Silenced next month unless the player intervenes

run_coffle.effect: a Catchers coffle leaves Pellet for Harrowgate along the Fifty-Five and the Ten; delivered after travel time unless stopped

cantor_move.effect: a Prophet threat move against the player if Hum exposure >= 3, else against a sub-faction's Turning countdown

march.effect: from 9:00: gang war of the Opened against an adjacent hold; win = Silenced

buy_burning_water.effect: advance Ba's trade; at three successes after 9:00 Burning Water is sold (seat silenced)

cantors.turn_check: crew with hum_exposure >= 3 roll +Hx each round
